sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
# Select publication year, empirical method type, and how many contributions used it that year
SELECT ?year ?methodTypeLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?contribution) AS ?count) WHERE {
  # Link paper to its contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to contributions of the Empirical Research Practice template
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  # Publication year of the paper
  ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
  # Data collection node of the contribution
  ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
  # Exclude contributions that report no data collection
  ?dc rdfs:label ?dcLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dcLabel)) != LCASE("no collection"))
  # Data collection method node
  ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?m .
  # Method type node of the collection method
  ?m orkgp:P94003 ?mt .
  # Human readable label of the method type
  ?mt rdfs:label ?methodTypeLabel .
  # Ignore placeholders that carry no method
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?methodTypeLabel)) != LCASE("no method"))
} GROUP BY ?year ?methodTypeLabel ORDER BY ?year DESC(?count)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
# Select the empirical method type and the number of contributions using it (overall frequency)
SELECT ?methodTypeLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?contribution) AS ?count) WHERE {
  # Restrict to contributions of the Empirical Research Practice template
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  # Data collection node of the contribution
  ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
  # Exclude contributions reporting no data collection
  ?dc rdfs:label ?dcLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dcLabel)) != LCASE("no collection"))
  # Data collection method node
  ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?m .
  # Method type of the collection method
  ?m orkgp:P94003 ?mt .
  # Human readable label of the method type
  ?mt rdfs:label ?methodTypeLabel .
  # Ignore the placeholder method type that carries no method
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?methodTypeLabel)) != LCASE("no method"))
} GROUP BY ?methodTypeLabel ORDER BY DESC(?count)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
# Select year and counts/shares of experiments, secondary research, surveys, case studies and action research among all methods that year
SELECT ?year (SUM(?exp) AS ?experiments) (SUM(?sec) AS ?secondaryResearch) (SUM(?sur) AS ?surveys) (SUM(?cas) AS ?caseStudies) (SUM(?act) AS ?actionResearch) (COUNT(*) AS ?totalMethods) ((xsd:decimal(SUM(?exp)) / xsd:decimal(COUNT(*))) AS ?experimentProportion) ((xsd:decimal(SUM(?sec)) / xsd:decimal(COUNT(*))) AS ?secondaryResearchProportion) ((xsd:decimal(SUM(?sur)) / xsd:decimal(COUNT(*))) AS ?surveyProportion) ((xsd:decimal(SUM(?cas)) / xsd:decimal(COUNT(*))) AS ?caseStudyProportion) ((xsd:decimal(SUM(?act)) / xsd:decimal(COUNT(*))) AS ?actionResearchProportion) WHERE {
  # Link paper to contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to contributions of the Empirical Research Practice template
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  # Publication year
  ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
  # Data collection node
  ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
  # Exclude contributions reporting no data collection
  ?dc rdfs:label ?dcLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dcLabel)) != LCASE("no collection"))
  # Data collection method node
  ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?m .
  # Method type node
  ?m orkgp:P94003 ?mt .
  # Method type label
  ?mt rdfs:label ?mtLabel .
  # Ignore placeholder method types
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?mtLabel)) != LCASE("no method"))
  # Flag each empirical method kind
  BIND(IF(LCASE(STR(?mtLabel)) = LCASE("experiment"), 1, 0) AS ?exp)
  BIND(IF(LCASE(STR(?mtLabel)) = LCASE("secondary research"), 1, 0) AS ?sec)
  BIND(IF(LCASE(STR(?mtLabel)) = LCASE("survey"), 1, 0) AS ?sur)
  BIND(IF(LCASE(STR(?mtLabel)) = LCASE("case study"), 1, 0) AS ?cas)
  BIND(IF(LCASE(STR(?mtLabel)) = LCASE("action research"), 1, 0) AS ?act)
} GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
# Select each publication and every statistical method it reports, so frequencies can be counted
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?statisticalMethodLabel WHERE {
  # Link paper to its contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to contributions of the Empirical Research Practice template
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  # Title of the publication
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Branch 1: inferential statistical tests reported for the data analysis
  {
    ?contribution orkgp:P15124 ?da .
    ?da orkgp:P56043 ?inferential .
    ?inferential orkgp:P35133 ?statTest .
    ?statTest rdfs:label ?statisticalMethodLabel .
  }
  # Branch 2: descriptive statistics measures reported for the data analysis
  UNION
  {
    ?contribution orkgp:P15124 ?da2 .
    ?da2 orkgp:P56048 ?descriptive .
    # Map each descriptive statistics group and measure to a readable method name
    VALUES (?groupProp ?measureProp ?statisticalMethodLabel) { (orkgp:P56049 orkgp:P55023 "count") (orkgp:P56049 orkgp:P56050 "percent") (orkgp:P57005 orkgp:P47000 "mean") (orkgp:P57005 orkgp:P57006 "median") (orkgp:P57005 orkgp:P57007 "mode") (orkgp:P57005 orkgp:P44107 "minimum") (orkgp:P57005 orkgp:P44108 "maximum") (orkgp:P57008 orkgp:P4013 "range") (orkgp:P57008 orkgp:P57009 "variance") (orkgp:P57008 orkgp:P44087 "standard deviation") (orkgp:P57010 orkgp:P59065 "boxplot") }
    ?descriptive ?groupProp ?measureGroup .
    # The measure must be reported as used (boolean true)
    ?measureGroup ?measureProp true .
  }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
# Select year, statistical method, and number of contributions using it that year
SELECT ?year ?statisticalMethodLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?contribution) AS ?count) WHERE {
  # Link paper to its contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to contributions of the Empirical Research Practice template
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  # Publication year
  ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
  # Branch 1: inferential statistical tests
  {
    ?contribution orkgp:P15124 ?da .
    ?da orkgp:P56043 ?inferential .
    ?inferential orkgp:P35133 ?statTest .
    ?statTest rdfs:label ?statisticalMethodLabel .
  }
  # Branch 2: descriptive statistics measures reported as used
  UNION
  {
    ?contribution orkgp:P15124 ?da2 .
    ?da2 orkgp:P56048 ?descriptive .
    # Map descriptive statistics group and measure predicates to readable names
    VALUES (?groupProp ?measureProp ?statisticalMethodLabel) { (orkgp:P56049 orkgp:P55023 "count") (orkgp:P56049 orkgp:P56050 "percent") (orkgp:P57005 orkgp:P47000 "mean") (orkgp:P57005 orkgp:P57006 "median") (orkgp:P57005 orkgp:P57007 "mode") (orkgp:P57005 orkgp:P44107 "minimum") (orkgp:P57005 orkgp:P44108 "maximum") (orkgp:P57008 orkgp:P4013 "range") (orkgp:P57008 orkgp:P57009 "variance") (orkgp:P57008 orkgp:P44087 "standard deviation") (orkgp:P57010 orkgp:P59065 "boxplot") }
    ?descriptive ?groupProp ?measureGroup .
    # Measure is used only when reported as true
    ?measureGroup ?measureProp true .
  }
} GROUP BY ?year ?statisticalMethodLabel ORDER BY ?year DESC(?count)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
# Select each reported threat-to-validity type and how many contributions report it
SELECT ?threatTypeLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?contribution) AS ?count) WHERE {
  # Restrict to contributions of the Empirical Research Practice template
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  # Threats to validity node of the contribution
  ?contribution orkgp:P39099 ?threats .
  # Map every threat-to-validity predicate to its human readable type name
  VALUES (?threatProp ?threatTypeLabel) { (orkgp:P55037 "construct validity") (orkgp:P55035 "internal validity") (orkgp:P55034 "external validity") (orkgp:P55036 "conclusion validity") (orkgp:P59109 "reliability") (orkgp:P60006 "generalizability") (orkgp:P97002 "repeatability") (orkgp:P68005 "content validity") (orkgp:P97000 "descriptive validity") (orkgp:P97001 "theoretical validity") (orkgp:P145000 "mentioned but not classified") }
  # Retrieve the reported value for that threat type
  ?threats ?threatProp ?threatValue .
  # Keep only threat types that are actually reported
  FILTER(?threatValue = true)
} GROUP BY ?threatTypeLabel ORDER BY DESC(?count)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
# Select year with case study and action research counts and their share of all methods that year
SELECT ?year (SUM(?caseF) AS ?caseStudies) (SUM(?actionF) AS ?actionResearch) (COUNT(*) AS ?totalMethods) ((xsd:decimal(SUM(?caseF)) / xsd:decimal(COUNT(*))) AS ?caseStudyProportion) ((xsd:decimal(SUM(?actionF)) / xsd:decimal(COUNT(*))) AS ?actionResearchProportion) WHERE {
  # Link paper to its contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to contributions of the Empirical Research Practice template
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  # Publication year
  ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
  # Data collection node
  ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
  # Exclude contributions reporting no data collection
  ?dc rdfs:label ?dcLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dcLabel)) != LCASE("no collection"))
  # Data collection method node
  ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?m .
  # Method type node
  ?m orkgp:P94003 ?mt .
  # Method type label
  ?mt rdfs:label ?mtLabel .
  # Ignore placeholder method types
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?mtLabel)) != LCASE("no method"))
  # Flag case studies
  BIND(IF(LCASE(STR(?mtLabel)) = LCASE("case study"), 1, 0) AS ?caseF)
  # Flag action research
  BIND(IF(LCASE(STR(?mtLabel)) = LCASE("action research"), 1, 0) AS ?actionF)
} GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
# Select year with counts of papers providing data URLs, data types, and their proportions
SELECT ?year (COUNT(?contribution) AS ?total) (SUM(?withUrl) AS ?withDataUrl) (SUM(?withType) AS ?withDataType) ((xsd:decimal(SUM(?withUrl)) / xsd:decimal(COUNT(?contribution))) AS ?urlProportion) ((xsd:decimal(SUM(?withType)) / xsd:decimal(COUNT(?contribution))) AS ?typeProportion) WHERE {
  # Subquery: one row per contribution flagging whether the collected data is identified/shared
  {
    SELECT ?contribution (MAX(?u) AS ?withUrl) (MAX(?t) AS ?withType) WHERE {
      # Restrict to contributions of the Empirical Research Practice template
      ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
      # Data collection node
      ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
      # Collected data node
      ?dc orkgp:DATA ?data .
      # Data identified by a URL (materials, raw data, results)
      OPTIONAL { ?data orkgp:url ?dataUrl . BIND(1 AS ?u1) }
      # Data with a reported data type
      OPTIONAL { ?data orkgp:P7055 ?dataType . BIND(1 AS ?t1) }
      # Collapse optional bindings to 0 when absent
      BIND(COALESCE(?u1,0) AS ?u)
      BIND(COALESCE(?t1,0) AS ?t)
    } GROUP BY ?contribution
  }
  # Link contribution to publication
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  # Publication year
  ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
} GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
# Select the concrete method names used to conduct secondary research and how often they occur
SELECT ?methodName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?contribution) AS ?count) WHERE {
  # Restrict to contributions of the Empirical Research Practice template
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  # Data collection node
  ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
  # Data collection method node
  ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?method .
  # Method type of the collection method
  ?method orkgp:P94003 ?methodType .
  # Method type label
  ?methodType rdfs:label ?methodTypeLabel .
  # Keep only secondary research (integrative and interpretive literature reviews)
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?methodTypeLabel)) = LCASE("secondary research"))
  # Exact reported name of the method used for the review
  ?method orkgp:P145012 ?methodName .
} GROUP BY ?methodName ORDER BY DESC(?count)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
# Select year with the number of secondary research methods and their share of all empirical methods
SELECT ?year (SUM(?isSecondary) AS ?secondaryResearchMethods) (COUNT(*) AS ?totalMethods) ((xsd:decimal(SUM(?isSecondary)) / xsd:decimal(COUNT(*))) AS ?proportion) WHERE {
  # Link paper to its contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to contributions of the Empirical Research Practice template
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  # Publication year
  ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
  # Data collection node
  ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
  # Exclude contributions reporting no data collection
  ?dc rdfs:label ?dcLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dcLabel)) != LCASE("no collection"))
  # Data collection method node
  ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?method .
  # Method type node
  ?method orkgp:P94003 ?methodType .
  # Method type label
  ?methodType rdfs:label ?methodTypeLabel .
  # Ignore placeholder method types
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?methodTypeLabel)) != LCASE("no method"))
  # Flag secondary research methods
  BIND(IF(LCASE(STR(?methodTypeLabel)) = LCASE("secondary research"), 1, 0) AS ?isSecondary)
} GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
# Select how many distinct research methods a publication uses, and how many publications fall in each bucket
SELECT ?methodCount (COUNT(*) AS ?publications) WHERE {
  # Subquery: count distinct empirical research methods per publication
  {
    SELECT ?paper (COUNT(DISTINCT ?methodTypeLabel) AS ?methodCount) WHERE {
      # Link paper to its contribution
      ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
      # Restrict to contributions of the Empirical Research Practice template
      ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
      # Data collection node
      ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
      # Data collection method node
      ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?method .
      # Method type node of the collection method
      ?method orkgp:P94003 ?methodType .
      # Human readable method type label
      ?methodType rdfs:label ?methodTypeLabel .
      # Ignore the placeholder method type that carries no method
      FILTER(LCASE(STR(?methodTypeLabel)) != LCASE("no method"))
    } GROUP BY ?paper
  }
} GROUP BY ?methodCount ORDER BY ?methodCount
